<h3>Furnishings</h3>
<p></div></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  text-padding" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p style="text-align: left;">We have holiday apartments with single and/or double beds and a sofa bed, altogether accommodating up to six people. All apartments come with well-equipped kitchens with coffee machines, kettles, pots/pans and tableware service. In the living room you’ll find a complete set of furniture and TV with channels where you can lean back and relax.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">All holiday apartments have a private outdoor area in the form of a balcony, porch or patio, where you can enjoy meals and time together. You are welcome to bring your own barbecue or use the campground’s shared barbecue grill.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">You can find out more about the individual holiday apartments further down the page, where you will also find pictures and floor plans.</p>

			<div class="vc_single_image-wrapper   vc_box_border_grey layzr-bg"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="800" height="480" src="data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,%3Csvg xmlns%3D'http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg' viewBox%3D'0 0 800 480'%2F%3E" data-src="https://www.drejby.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/hytte.jpg" class="lazy-load vc_single_image-img attachment-full" alt="ferienhütten" title="hytte"  data-dt-location="https://www.drejby.dk/hytte-5/" /></div>
		</figure>
	</div>
<div id="ultimate-heading-67996acd5664b8e97" class="uvc-heading ult-adjust-bottom-margin ultimate-heading-67996acd5664b8e97 uvc-8498  uvc-heading-default-font-sizes" data-hspacer="no_spacer"  data-halign="center" style="text-align:center"><div class="uvc-heading-spacer no_spacer" style="top"></div><div class="uvc-main-heading ult-responsive"  data-ultimate-target='.uvc-heading.ultimate-heading-67996acd5664b8e97 h2'  data-responsive-json-new='{"font-size":"","line-height":""}' ><h2 style="--font-weight:theme;margin-top:30px;">Cabins</h2></div></div><div class="vc_empty_space"   style="height: 32px"><span class="vc_empty_space_inner"></span></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p style="text-align: center;">Our cabins are for four persons, and<br />
many with own toilet, extra sink and television.</p>

		</div>
	</div>
<style></style><div class="btn-align-center"><a href="https://www.drejby.com/holiday-cabins/" class="default-btn-shortcode dt-btn dt-btn-s link-hover-off  vc_custom_1705655232212" id="default-btn-17ca81ea5bb8c7bb9df107d33b4082fb"><span>Read about cabins</span></a></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-4"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div  class="wpb_single_image wpb_content_element vc_align_center">
		
		<figure class="wpb_wrapper vc_figure">
			<div class="vc_single_image-wrapper   vc_box_border_grey layzr-bg"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="800" height="480" src="data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,%3Csvg xmlns%3D'http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg' viewBox%3D'0 0 800 480'%2F%3E" data-src="https://www.drejby.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/pladsen-aftenstemning-2.jpg" class="lazy-load vc_single_image-img attachment-full" alt="Camping på Als i Sønderjylland" title="Camping på Als, i Sønderjylland"  data-dt-location="https://www.drejby.dk/pladsen-aftenstemning-2-2/" /></div>
		</figure>
	</div>
<div id="ultimate-heading-98196acd5664b9db9" class="uvc-heading ult-adjust-bottom-margin ultimate-heading-98196acd5664b9db9 uvc-2136  uvc-heading-default-font-sizes" data-hspacer="no_spacer"  data-halign="center" style="text-align:center"><div class="uvc-heading-spacer no_spacer" style="top"></div><div class="uvc-main-heading ult-responsive"  data-ultimate-target='.uvc-heading.ultimate-heading-98196acd5664b9db9 h2'  data-responsive-json-new='{"font-size":"","line-height":""}' ><h2 style="--font-weight:theme;margin-top:30px;">Camping</h2></div></div><div class="vc_empty_space"   style="height: 32px"><span class="vc_empty_space_inner"></span></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p style="text-align: center;">Drejby Strand Camping has 450 pitches for<br />
tent, caravans and campers.</p>

		</div>
	</div>
<style></style><div class="btn-align-center"><a href="https://www.drejby.com/camping-pitches/" class="default-btn-shortcode dt-btn dt-btn-s link-hover-off  vc_custom_1705655278684" id="default-btn-4b9cd285e74706fdd7b81b621d84cd39"><span>Read about camping</span></a></div></div></div></div></div><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid dt-default" style="margin-top: 0px;margin-bottom: 0px"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p></p>

		</div>
	</div>
</div></div></div></div><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid dt-default" style="margin-top: 100px;margin-bottom: 50px"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-6"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h3>Holiday apartments for up to six people</h3>
<p>At Drejby Strand Camping, we rent six different and attractive holiday apartments with space for two to six people. Here you can enjoy a get-away with your partner or friends – or you can take your family on a cozy and fun vacation in Southern Jutland filled with activities and relaxation on the beach. The holiday apartments provide you with a comfortable stay in beautiful surroundings while enjoying the countryside and the lively holiday atmosphere at the campground.</p>

		</div>
	</div>
</div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-6"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h3>Practical info</h3>
<p>Our holiday apartments are equipped with all everyday domestic items. In the bedroom you will find duvets and pillows, but you must bring your own bed linens, towels, dish towels/dish cloths and personal necessities. If you want to save space in your suitcase or car trunk, you can also choose to rent towels and bed linens here at the campground. Please let us know when you book your holiday apartment – and we’ll make everything ready for you.</p>

		</div>
	</div>
</div></div></div></div><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid dt-default" style="margin-top: 100px;margin-bottom: 50px"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-6"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h3>Cleaning the holiday apartments</h3>
<p>We want all our guests to feel comfortable in our holiday apartments. Therefore, all apartments have been cleaned when you check into them – and they should be left in the same condition when your stay has ended. Bring your own cleaning supplies such as washcloths and soap. If you want to avoid cleaning yourself, you can order a final cleaning of the apartment and we’ll take care of it.</p>

		</div>
	</div>
</div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-6"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h3>Holiday atmosphere at the campground</h3>
<p>Rent a holiday apartment at Drejby Strand Camping and enjoy the many benefits of camping in a more luxurious setting. With one of our holiday apartments, you’ll find lots of comfort and extra indoor space, while still having access to many fun activities, common areas, events and much more. Enjoy the campground’s nice vacation atmosphere and let the kids play with the other children on the playground.</p>

		</div>
	</div>
</div></div></div></div><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid dt-default" style="margin-top: 100px;margin-bottom: 50px"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-6"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h3>Holiday apartments offer</h3>
<p>We occasionally have great offers on holiday apartments – also during sought after periods and public holidays. However, you must be quick if you want to get hold of one of our six holiday apartments before everyone else, so you can enjoy a comfortable, cozy and wonderful vacation in Southern Jutland.</p>
<p><a href="https://www.drejby.com/offers-and-packages/">See our offers and prices here</a></p>

		</div>
	</div>
</div></div></div></div>
</div>
	</div>

	


			</div>
